en.title: Good Strings
en.description:
Count the strings of n lowercase letters in which the absolute difference between the alphabet positions of every two adjacent letters is at most d, modulo 1,000,000,007.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: One line with n d. Constraints added by this site: 1≤n≤100000, 0≤d≤25.
en.output: Output the number of valid strings modulo 1,000,000,007.
en.explanation: Use dynamic programming over the last letter; a new character can only transition from last-letter states that differ from it by at most d.
hints: Use dynamic programming over the last letter; a new character can only transition from last-letter states that differ from it by at most d.
